metadata.title: SpaceX shares could trade like Tesla shares — detached from fundamentals - MarketWatch

content.text:
13 hours ago
SpaceX shares could trade like Tesla shares — detached from fundamentals
When SpaceX filed its S-1 form with the SEC last month, plenty of investors focused on the company's lack of profitability. And although some may have an issue with SpaceX's business fundamentals, there's a chance the stock's moves are detached from them — just like they are with Tesla's.
Tesla is a popular stock among retail investors. However, many of these investors trade the stock based on technical patterns instead of fundamentals, or use it as a proxy for investing in Elon Musk.
"I think it’s an interesting look at how people are willing to value upside in Elon,” said Joe Mazzola, head trading and derivatives strategist at Charles Schwab. “It’ll be a really interesting day on Friday as we watch the tape move.”
